lauren-cs: Hey team — customer AcmeHealth reports their nightly embedding job started failing with 403 after their SSO rotation last night. They say it used to run fine for hours and then errors out mid-batch. Help?

raj-support: Thanks Lauren. Can you paste the error payload they see? Any request_id or trace id?

lauren-cs: Paste from their logs (redacted):
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: r-0a1b2c3d
{
  "error": {
    "type": "insufficient_scope",
    "message": "missing scope: embeddings",
    "hint": "token entitlements do not include embeddings/rerank"
  }
}
```
They also included a snippet of the Authorization JWT header decode (base64 redacted):
```
{
  "sub": "svcacct:acme-prod",
  "scopes": "inference; rerank;  embeddings",
  "iss": "sso-idp.acme",
  "exp": 1700000000
}
```
Note the scopes string has `;` semicolons and an extra leading space before `embeddings`.

tom-runtime: Hmm, our scope parser historically accepts comma- or space-separated lists. Semicolons have been flaky in a few edge parsers, especially if provisioning ran a trim+join step. If the claim contains "  embeddings" (leading space) some downstream equality checks may fail.

maria-auth: @tom-runtime good catch. We normalize by splitting on `[ ,]+` in most places but a few older auth microservices still use strict `split(';')` for legacy SSO payloads. Semicolon + space yields an empty token then a value with leading space. Our `entitlement-matcher` then does exact string matching, so "embeddings" != " embeddings".

lauren-cs: Customer says they provisioned via SCIM and rotated keys via their IdP. They didn't change scope names. Worked before rotation. They attached their SCIM delta which shows the scopes column as `inference;rerank; embeddings` (note the unescaped space).

olivia-sre: Can we reproduce?

tom-runtime: Repro steps I'm trying locally: 1) create a JWT with `scopes` claim using semicolon separated list with a space before the last scope. 2) call our embeddings endpoint `/v1/embeddings`. 3) watch auth service logs. I'll attach command.

tom-runtime: ```bash
# generate test JWT (dev key)
PAYLOAD='{\"sub\":\"svcacct:test\",\"scopes\":\"inference;rerank; embeddings\"}'
# sign... (dev-only)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_JWT" -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"foo"}' -v
```

deploy-bot: deploy: auth/entitlement-matcher v2.1.3 promoted to staging at 2026-03-15T03:12Z

olivia-sre: Tom, what did the staging logs show?

tom-runtime: Staging auth logs: `matched_scopes=[]` for that request_id. Downstream reject reason `missing scope: embeddings`. I also saw `scope_normalization=false` flag in the older matcher instance.

maria-auth: Looks like the root cause is provisioning sending semicolon-separated scopes with inconsistent trimming. Our newer matcher v2 normalizes on `[; ,]` and trims tokens, but the older v1 instances (still running in some Dedicated customer regions) split only on semicolon and do no trimming. For customers whose traffic hit the older instance after the SSO rotation, tokens with the leading space fail entitlement checks.

raj-support: Customer asks: Why only after rotation?

lauren-cs: Because the IdP rotation created a new JWT payload derived from their SCIM CSV where the last scope field had a leading space in that row. Old tokens had been normalized previously via a manual fix; the new rotation re-introduced the raw CSV artifact.

maria-auth: Fix options:
- short-term: advise customer to re-provision with trimmed scopes (SCIM CSV: remove the space) OR create an API service-key for the job with explicit `embeddings` and `rerank` scopes.
- mid-term: roll out v2 matcher to all regions and add normalization on the legacy v1.

tom-runtime: I've opened internal ticket INF-7123 to sweep Dedicated nodes and bump entitlement-matcher to v2.1.3. Also adding a quick middleware to trim whitespace on tokens as a hotfix for the next patch release.

olivia-sre: Can we provide a bandaid script for customers who can't reprovision immediately? Maybe a CLI snippet to reissue a service key with required scopes.

lauren-cs: I'll send the customer this script and the mitigations. Draft message: "We believe the 403s are caused by a whitespace artifact in the SSO-scopes claim after rotation. Short-term workaround: re-provision the SCIM entry with trimmed scopes or create a dedicated service key that includes `embeddings` and `rerank` scopes. We're also rolling out an auth hotfix to normalize scopes across all regions."

raj-support: Please include this repro cmd and the example token header in the reply. Also ask for one failing request_id so we can trace which region/version matched them.

lauren-cs: Will do. Sending now and escalating to enterprise success for any customer billing impact.

maria-auth: After we patch, let's add a unit test for the `scopes` parser that covers "inference;rerank; embeddings" and "inference, rerank, embeddings" and plain space-delimited variants.

tom-runtime: Agreed. Also logging improvement: when `matched_scopes=[]` we should log raw `scopes` claim (redacted) so we can spot whitespace issues quickly. I'll add an item to INF-7123.

lauren-cs: Customer replied: thanks, they'll try reprovisioning now and will share a failing request_id if it persists. :thumbsup:

olivia-sre: Marking this thread for follow-up in 24h.

lauren-cs: closing loop for now; will reopen if customer still sees 403s.
